bluf: Transmission is an independent B2B demand generation agency, region Europe, calling itself the world's largest independent B2B marketing agency with 250+ employees; the record lists no HQ and no offices. It leads with B2B & ABM and sells brand, ABX, paid media, content and B2B SEO & GEO under an AI story built on Propulsion OS. The record shows a 2025 awards run and a work index whose newest case is dated 2025-08-05, with 0 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days. A rival should know it sells LinkedIn led demand with no LinkedIn ads of its own, lists no pricing, and 8 of its clients sit on other tracked books.
doing:
The positioning line reads: independent global B2B agency pairing human talent with AI across growth consulting, brand, go to market and demand programmes; in plain words, a brand led B2B campaign shop with an AI delivery layer and a demand offer. The headline claim, the world's largest independent B2B marketing agency with 250+ employees, is quoted as a claim; the record lists no founding year, HQ or offices.

The sold mix leads with B2B & ABM (score 3: the meta sells it as a global B2B agency; ABX, demand conversion, an ABM insights stream). Scoring 2: AI Automation / Agents (the About page launches Propulsion OS, an AI and automation delivery system), AI Search / GEO (GEO and AEO pitched for AI driven search; an insight article reports client impact), Content & Digital PR (a B2B content page plus thought leadership URLs), Paid Social (a B2B paid media page selling omnichannel buying; LinkedIn Content Partner terms linked site wide, the only partner listed) and SEO (a B2B SEO & GEO page citing work for CAD software maker Bricsys). Other lines score 1 or 0, with Creator & Influencer, Local and Retail Media at 0.

Its AI posture is human expertise plus AI: Propulsion OS as the agency operating system, an AI content engine sold as a service, and SEO and GEO for AI driven B2B search; no audited AI visibility product shows in the record. The dated moves are 2025 awards: North America agency of the year at the 2025 B2B Marketing Elevation Awards plus two more wins, and Gold at The Drum Awards 2025 for an inspiring rebrand or relaunch. News and jobs lists are empty, no ATS is recorded, and the insights index was last dated 2026-01-05. The record lists no pricing model. Conspicuously absent for a demand agency: measurement depth behind paid media, any advertising of its own, and an office footprint.
clients:

The book on record is 24 clients, 15 observed and 9 names only, from 6 case studies and 18 slugs; the rows Internationally awarded and a second JCB row are title artifacts.

AutoStore, brand, B2B pipeline and AI (N3, N11, N9), the 2025-08-05 case credited with 4000%+ ROI and Best Brand Initiative; Snapdragon X Elite, brand (N3), the 2025-07-26 programme; Iron Mountain, B2B pipeline (N11), the 2025-05-02 Most Commercially Successful Campaign at the B2B Awards; Centrica, B2B pipeline (N11), the 2025-06-28 Powering Resilience content campaign; Cloudflare, B2B pipeline (N11), the 2024-04-23 shift to targeted ABM; JCB, brand (N3), the 2025-04-02 Better With Omotenashi campaign; Software AG (N3, brand to demand, 2024-04-03), Fujifilm (N3, Built on Tape, 2024-03-21), ADP (N3, People Unboxed, 2023-05-25), Vodafone (N3, Software Defined Networking, 2023-05-10), Outseer (N3, N4, N5, positioning, identity and website, 2023-06-07), HP Wolf Security (N3, 2022-01-23) and Adarma (N3, N5, repositioning, 2022-01-01) are older brand cases.

Third, Propulsion OS and an AI content engine are sold, but no audited AI visibility product is on record and the llms.txt check did not complete; an audited number is likely to beat the story, moderate confidence. Contestable: the 8 shared accounts, Cloudflare, Samsung and Allianz first, and the 9 names only rows with no described work. No public pricing: transparent outcome pricing is a conversation it cannot hold. Most exposed to KJ5, it is very likely to feel walled garden inflation on its weakest lines, low confidence on thin evidence.
